text: The meeting established that a written project plan will be prepared and delivered by the next meeting (0).

It was agreed to produce a written plan detailing functional design, technical design, number of team members, timeframe, budget and market plan, and that the written project plan will be provided within two weeks (1, 4).
A problem was identified: there is confusion about the project goal and no written functional/technical design or project plan, and the team has not begun design work (2).
The product scope was decided as a remote control for television (3).

Action items include coordinating usability testing, starting to determine the functional design, conducting market research on remote controls, and developing a cost and marketing plan with pricing and market strategy (5, 6, 7).
